provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1608 CANDLER DR, ARLINGTON, TX, 76011

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: During the inspection one child was observed using their personal Ipad throughout the inspection. Based on information gathered during the inspection the child is using the ipad for accommodations, that are not documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: Only two of the six classrooms at the operation had emergency evacuation and relocation diagrams posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Not Used On or Near Hard, Slippery Surface: During the inspection multiple children were observed using a sprinkler on/near concrete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Not Used On or Near Hard, Slippery Surface (26 TAC §746.5015(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Multiple children files were no located during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two children in care have known food allergies with FARE forms not signed by the physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: A copy of the fire inspection was not made available for review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The bus driver did not display good judgement when they allowed a child to go inside a gas station alone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The bus driver did not have adequate supervision when they allowed a child to go into a gas station alone. They were unable to intervene if necessary.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation did not report to licensing withing 48 hours, an injury that required medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: 1203(5)- This standard was evaluated as a result of a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.  Through interviews with staff, it was determined that a caregiver used harsh tones with children and did not interact in a positive manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs: This standard was evaluated as a result of a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.  Classrooms were observed to be not following the activity plan due to the children being out of control.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201)

occurrences.finding: Driver Has Current Driver's License: It was determined that a staff person has transported children on bus runs, without a current driver's license.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Driver Has Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.5617(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who left employment in 2025, by the required date of 1/15/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization: While an incident report was done, the report was not complete and did not include all of the required information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Written feeding instructions were not current for 4 infants who are not yet on table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director does not have current training in one of the three trainings required for caring for children under the age of 24 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required: Five of ten personnel records reviewed are missing trainings in child growth and development, curriculum and teacher interaction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Six of ten personnel records reviewed are missing training in prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose fill on the pre-k playground is 3 inches in depth.     Minimum standards state that play structures five feet or less have to maintain a depth of six inches in loose fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The toddler playground needs to be maintained to ensure that loose fill is at the proper depth of 6 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.     The director called the fire department and scheduled an inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The paint is chipping on the windowsill in the toddler rooms.    The vent on the wall has visible dirt present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection reported stated the operation needed to clean the floors throughout. The floors were stained with dirt and grime throughout the kitchen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3405)

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: The carpet in the schoolers room is stained, the furniture in the classrooms have visible dirt on them.    The shelves in the rooms are cracked and chipping.     Two buses were viewed with old food wrappers, empty bottles and misc. paper on the floor of the buses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: A tricycle on the toddler playground was broken and cracked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: One sink in the three years bathroom did not have running water.     The other sink had a faulty spout and when turned on would cause water to drip onto the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the amount of deficiencies cited today the director is not ensuring that the operation is being ran in compliance with minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram: The school age classroom did not have an emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram (26 TAC §746.401(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: The director and operation's driver did not have current transportation safety training.  Both will need to complete 2 clock hours of transportation safety training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: Eight infants did not have current infant feeding instructions on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: Current activity plans were not posted in the following classrooms:  infant, pre-k, and school age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Two children's admission information did not include the name, address, and telephone number of the child's physician or an emergency-care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - TB Test: Three caregivers did not have a current TB test on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - TB Test (26 TAC §746.901(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Two children lacked the name and telephone number of the school that the child attends.   (Note:  School information was updated for both children during the inspection.)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Six caregivers did not complete trainings in the following topics:      (1) Emergency preparedness   (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases,   (3)Administering medication  (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction  (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety  (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials     One caregiver will need to complete prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment and SIDS, shaken baby, and early brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child lacked authorization for emergency medical care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child did not have an immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver inappropriately disciplined children while in care.  The caregiver disciplined children by grabbing them by their arm and/or by their shirt.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The operation has not ordered the loose fill to maintain compliance after the last inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was working at the operation prior to receiving a background check status result of eligible, eligible with conditions, or provisionally eligible. The caregiver was placed in a classroom to help with ratios during the inspection. The caregiver was then removed and placed in a room to finish working on training and did not have access to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The infant classroom had three caregiverse with 15 infants. There were 9 infants that were 0-11 months and 6 infants that were 12-17 months. The secificate age group was 0-11 months. This was corrected at inspection when the infant classroom sperated and two caregivers took the older infants to the other infant side and two caregivers stayed in the same area with the younger infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Loose fill on two playgrounds were not maintained to the required depth. Cement was exposed under the slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: A table in the larger playground had the top layer ripped and exposing sharp edges.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation did not have the required updated playground checklist. The last checklist was dated for May 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
